Oe.bar_b_note: The naturalistic moss-backed hare is a Palworld-finish creature model that clearly towers over the ruler, held back only by the flat blue/white swim slab (A) and the hovering carry pose (B).

At.bar_b_note: A warm, readable elder villager with an earthy green/brown palette that sits comfortably beside Palworld's stylised humans and the key art's settlement.

Ll.bar_b_note: The large mossy-shelled tortoise has a grounded anatomy and surface detail at the bar's level, dented by the floating carry frame (A) and the flat blue slab with a blown-white edge in the swim frame (B).

Ij.bar_b_note: Smeared low-resolution ground, a flat sky, sparse lollipop trees and a blocky tiled tunnel wall have none of Palworld's density or Valheim's light, though B's freed captive, smoke and torn banners do give each aftermath a story.

Qv.bar_b_note: B's lightning-veined wolf matches the Tanglevolt bar, but A's material switches to a pied black/white look and floats in the faint frames, and B's faint end tips the wolf onto its nose.

Od.bar_b_note: A's timber frame with a brace, a cap and a stone footing reads as built, but the faceted low-res boulder, flat lake and plain grade keep the scene well below Palworld base-building finish, and B's blown-white card sinks it.

Bw.bar_b_note: Same strong naturalistic hare model as Oe, held back by the flat swim slab (A) and the hovering carry (B).

Wz.bar_b_note: Same convincing mossy tortoise as Ll; the swim slab with a blown-white edge (A) and the airborne carry (B) are the only things breaking the read.

top_changes.change: Replace the flat blue gradient swim slab (with its blown-white right edge) with a real water surface at the waterline, and ground the carrying poses so creatures do not hover above their shadows

Raise the Meadows ground and set dressing in the world sets (Ij, Od): sharper terrain materials in place of smeared ground, grove/edge vegetation density, atmospheric fog and a warm sun grade, and replace the low-res faceted boulder and blocky tunnel walls
Lock each creature to one material across all states (Qv A's faint frames switch to pied black/white) and fix faint-end poses that float or tip onto the nose (Qv A/B)
